instruction: Configure LibreOffice Impress to automatically save presentations every 5 minutes

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 5 minutes. The evaluator checks the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property in the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify it's set to 5.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical uncertainty about unit of measurement: LibreOffice may store AutoSaveTimeIntervall in seconds (300) rather than minutes (5), which would cause the evaluator to fail even when task is correctly completed
The metric function expects the raw XML value to equal 5, but if LibreOffice stores the interval as 300 seconds (5 minutes), the comparison will fail
The evaluator logic is otherwise correct: proper XML parsing, correct path and property name lookup, appropriate error handling
Coverage is complete: the single requirement (set auto-save to 5 minutes) is fully checked
State accessibility is good: uses vm_file getter to read persistent config file, no postconfig needed
Expected value semantic correctness cannot be verified without knowing LibreOffice's actual storage format
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Verify the actual unit LibreOffice uses for AutoSaveTimeIntervall in registrymodifications.xcu (seconds vs minutes)
If LibreOffice stores in seconds, change expected value from 5 to 300 in the rules
Alternatively, if storing in seconds, add unit conversion logic in the metric function to convert seconds to minutes before comparison
Consider adding a test with a real LibreOffice config file to validate the expected value format
Add logging in the metric to show the actual value found in the XML for debugging
